left.looking: the car's left (driver) side; the front of the car is toward the left of the drawing

right.looking: the car's right (passenger) side; the front of the car is toward the right of the drawing

front.looking: the front of the car, head on; the car's left side is on the right of the drawing

rear.looking: the back of the car; the car's left side is on the left of the drawing

top.looking: straight down from above, lined up with the left view: the front of the car is toward the left of the drawing and its left side is at the bottom
